paths.code-review-fix.md: #3190: the --auto convergence loop rewrote REVIEW.md every re-review iteration but never recommitted it (committed REVIEW.md stayed at iteration 1, contradicting the committed REVIEW-FIX.md), and the commit-fix step's two inline frontmatter validators exported REVIEW_PATH into a node -e body that reads process.env.FIX_REPORT_PATH — so HAS_STATUS/FIX_FRONTMATTER were always empty and REVIEW-FIX.md was never committed at all. The fix renames the exported env var to FIX_REPORT_PATH at both validator sites, stages the converged REVIEW.md alongside REVIEW-FIX.md in the single --auto docs commit (guarded on AUTO_MODE so non-auto single-pass runs are untouched), and removes the spent .iterN.md backups on successful convergence (retained on degradation for post-mortem). Growth is the deployed contract for those three coupled fixes plus inline rationale comments; the regression test is tests/code-review-fix-pipeline-regression.test.cjs.
